detail: A box plus red dye returns a recoloured box with custom data intact. Adding a diamond to a third slot still returns a result. The custom matches() does not reject unrelated non-null slots; those items can consequently be consumed by crafting.
recommended_change: Require exactly one box and one recognized dye, reject every unrelated slot, and test container contents, names, all colours and extra-input rejection.
title: Shulker recolouring accepts unrelated extra items

detail: Mutating the returned smithing preview tag changes the input tag. getCraftingResult() assigns the input compound directly rather than copying it. Earlier smithing tests verified retained values, not ownership isolation.

title: Smithing output shares input NBT

detail: Every listed recipe was queried with mapped modern ingredients and has no matching output for at least one tested witness.
